title: Still Life
author: Louise Penny
summary: In a hidden Quebec village, a beloved retired teacher is found dead in the woods, seemingly the victim of a hunting accident. Chief Inspector Armand Gamache arrives and starts to suspect it was murder.
readIf: you like gentle, humane mysteries with a charming village and a kind, intelligent detective.
skipIf: you want a fast, dark thriller, as the focus is on character and community.

pairings.reason: Another warm, funny whodunit with a lovable community and an easy rhythm.
A bigger-city detective story with a similar patient, character-led approach.
A classic puzzle mystery that shares the pleasure of a wide circle of suspects.
